note: Events a REAL external agent (claude CLI) managed to record in session 1 of the Phase 16 real-agent test; 23 of 32 attempts were rejected. Content is a toy repository.

payload.goal: Investigate authentication and fix the session timeout bug in auth.py/test_auth.py, run tests, commit smallest correct change, leave README TTL note as unfinished item

payload.title: Session timeout bug: SESSION_TTL_MINUTES was 15 instead of 60
payload.description: In auth.py, SESSION_TTL_MINUTES was set to 15, causing sessions to expire after 15 minutes. test_auth.py::test_a_session_lives_for_an_hour expects sessions to remain valid at 45 minutes and expire by 61, implying an intended 60-minute TTL.

payload.title: Fix session timeout TTL from 15 to 60 minutes
payload.approach: Changed the SESSION_TTL_MINUTES constant in auth.py from 15 to 60, the smallest change matching test_auth.py's expectation of an hour-long session.
